description: The whole Settings → Taxes screen: every tax group, the rates inside it in charging order, and each rate’s percentage at each outlet. Answers 'what sales tax do I charge', 'what tax applies in the King Street store', 'which tax group is the standard one', 'do I charge GST and PST separately'. ALWAYS call this before any other tax tool — every other tool takes ids from here (tax group ids, tax rate ids, outlet ids) and none of them accept names. It also reports which rates are shared across groups and which belong to no group, both of which change what an edit will do. Read-only.
name: hub_get_taxes
title: Tax settings overview
